title: Understanding Model Risk
text: Model risk is the sum of bias squared, variance, and observational variance. When Ishani adds more features, the model risk decreases. This suggests a change in bias and/or variance.

title: Effect of Adding Features
text: Adding more features to a model can reduce bias but may increase variance. Consider how this tradeoff affects the model risk.

title: Calculate New Bias
text: Given the initial model risk of $$32$$, model variance of $$8$$, and observational variance of $$3$$, calculate the initial bias squared.

title: New Model Risk Components
text: With the new model risk of $$17$$ and observational variance of $$3$$, calculate the sum of the new bias squared and variance.

title: Determine New Variance
text: If the new model variance is $$15$$, what is the new bias squared?

title: Check Reasonableness
text: Consider if a negative bias squared is reasonable. What does this imply about the new variance value?
